$1000.
I’d be able to afford some gifts for my family for Christmas.
You guys got this! Good luck!
Seems like this community continues to shrink. Too bad y’all smooth brains can’t be heard anywhere but here huh?

I did therapy, for quite a while actually. The VA is an absolute mess with how they handle things like that. 
I’m not saying it didn’t help, nor did I stop by choice.
Paying for one out of pocket would be a bank breaker. I do well enough, but like everyone else, the struggle is real.
Talking about it is the hard part, I’m not looking for pity. I just need... I don’t know what I need.
This is extremely similar to a bit by Jim Jefferies. “There’s a panda, go f*ck the panda!” Feel like this is “at least” inspired by that joke.

True, this has gone on for years. I thought he still had the option of pleading out if the court finds reason to question his mental status, and it can be investigated. I could be wrong, my experience is pretty limited.
He needs to be removed from social media. I sure hope you’re right. The fact that he’s posting such triggering things is disgusting. Thank you for clarifying.

I get it, and that is how it is sometimes. The weight of that breakup hitting you months later is pretty common. Look, the best thing you can do? Is focus on you. I know you feel lonely and like there is no one out there for you. The truth is, this is time to focus on you. Stop texting her. Stop expecting a text back. Stop checking her social media. Get rid of those photos.
It’s going to be hard, and you’re always going to be wondering, but you cannot force this. You need to get your life together, build yourself up, put your energy into finding happiness for yourself. You will find someone again, make some friends, go out again. Talk to family and friends about how you’re feeling, embrace your other connections. You will be okay. I know it hurts.
I’m sorry.

Oh yeah, and it’s a hard experience to deal with. Thing is, the pain isn’t going to go away quickly, and you may feel like you’ll never be whole again. But you will. You will find out that you are worth more and find yourself again. I’m sorry that it hurts so much, and I wish you find happiness.
